Mikel Brown Jr. - Out: Brown, who finished with 18 points (5-13 FG, 3-8 3Pt, 5-7 FT), one rebound, three assists and one steal over 25 minutes in Saturday's 124-121 loss to Atlanta, won't play in Sunday's game against Dallas, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Egor Demin - Out: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.
Tobe Awaka - Day-To-Day: Awaka (knee) is questionable for Sundays' game against the 76ers.
Jalen Smith - Day-To-Day: Smith (finger) is probable for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.
Nic Claxton - Out: Claxton (hamstring) has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against the 76ers.
Zach Collins - Out: Collins (illness) is out for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.
Sergio de Larrea - Out: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against Utah.
Tarik Biberovic - Out: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.
Dereck Lively II - Out: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.
Isaiah Joe - Out: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lakers.
Isaac Jones - Day-To-Day: Jones posted 18 points (6-14 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 3-3 FT), 10 rebounds, an assist, two steals and two blocks in Wednesday's 100-88 Summer League loss to the Suns.
Elijah Harkless - Day-To-Day: Harkless signed a two-way contract with the Pistons, Keith Smith of Spotrac.com reports.
Jalen Duren - Out: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Brandon Ingram - Out: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Sunday's game against New Orleans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
Isaiah Jackson - Out: Jackson (groin) won't suit up for Sunday's game against the Pelicans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
Yanic Konan Niederhauser - Out: The Clippers recalled Niederhauser (foot) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.
Bradley Beal - Out: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Jordan Miller - Out: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
Luka Doncic - Day-To-Day: Doncic (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Pistons.
Joan Beringer - Day-To-Day: Beringer (nose) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Jazz.
Anthony Edwards - Out: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
Donte DiVincenzo - Out: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
Yves Missi - Out: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.
Joel Embiid - Day-To-Day: Embiid (foot) is probable for Sunday's game against the Bulls.
Adem Bona - Out: Bona (back) is out for Sunday's game in Chicago.
Dominick Barlow - Out: Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.
Ariel Hukporti - Out: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Keegan Murray - Out: Murray (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Heat.
Maxime Raynaud - Out: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
Ben Simmons - Out: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
Lauri Markkanen - Day-To-Day: Markkanen is questionable for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves due to a right wrist sprain.

Jusuf Nurkic - Out: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.
Jaren Jackson Jr. - Out: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
A.J. Greer - Injured Reserve: Greer (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday.
Troy Terry - Injured Reserve: Although Terry's (hip) return doesn't appear to be imminent, he is getting close to playing, Derek Lee of The Hockey News reports Saturday.
